name: Ryuji Kagami
passive: Balanced Fighter: no major penalties; reliable normals and anti-air.
strengths: Stable at all ranges; easy confirms; strong anti-air.
weaknesses: No extreme specialty; specialists outperform him in their preferred range.
design_notes: Black/red modern martial-arts outfit; protagonist silhouette; red energy accents.

name: Luna Valez
passive: Tempo: consecutive clean hits slightly improve movement speed for a short time.
strengths: Fast pressure; long combo routes; excellent mobility.
weaknesses: Low durability; weaker raw damage; vulnerable if pressure is interrupted.
design_notes: Red/black fashion-forward outfit; high-kick silhouette; elegant and fast.

name: Jack Iron
passive: Heavy Guard: selected heavy attacks have one-hit armor.
strengths: Huge damage; high HP; strong guard pressure.
weaknesses: Slow walk speed and recovery; can be zoned.
design_notes: Black/yellow sleeveless boxing coat; oversized gloves; heavyweight silhouette.

name: Mei Lin
combat_style: Japanese soft-style martial arts + palm techniques
passive: Flow Guard: successful just-guard reduces recovery and enables unique counters.
strengths: Best counter tools; strong defense; excellent punishment.
weaknesses: Lower proactive pressure; requires timing and matchup knowledge.
design_notes: Japanese-inspired white/deep-green outfit with obi/hakama elements. Name is a working name and can be changed later.

name: Kai Storm
passive: Flow Stance: selected moves transition into alternate low/high movement states.
strengths: Unpredictable movement; strong air game; cross-ups.
weaknesses: Risky on whiff; requires stance knowledge.
design_notes: Green/yellow/white street martial-arts outfit; dreadlocks; dynamic capoeira silhouette.

name: Akari
passive: Afterimage: perfect evasive movement briefly improves next attack startup.
strengths: Fastest movement; strong mix-ups; mobility and whiff punishment.
weaknesses: Lowest durability; mistakes are heavily punished.
design_notes: Black/purple tactical urban-ninja outfit; short hair; purple accents.

name: Viktor Volkov
passive: Iron Frame: reduced chip and guard damage; command grabs gain bonus damage near corner.
weaknesses: Very slow; struggles against projectiles and long-range control.
design_notes: Silver hair/beard; navy military-style coat with fur collar; massive grappler silhouette.

name: Noir
passive: Void Reserve: unique VOID meter enhances selected specials and teleport options.
strengths: Excellent range; strong mobility; flexible offense and control.
weaknesses: Resource dependent; strongest routes require VOID management.
design_notes: Silver hair; long black coat; blue-black energy; final-boss visual language.
